collect-candidate-file-http.py.script:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,urllib.parse
p=pathlib.Path('/root/storage-probe')
result=json.loads((p/'worker-observation.json').read_text())
config=json.loads((p/'worker-config.json').read_text())
def run(args,**kw):
    return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,**kw).strip()
def digest(path):
    with open(path,'rb') as f:return 'sha256:'+hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def kube(*args):return json.loads(run(['/usr/local/bin/k3s','kubectl',*args,'-o','json']))
def sql(db,query):
    return json.loads(run(['sudo','-u','postgres','psql','-X','-A','-t','-d',db,'-c',query]))
org=result['organization']
assert org.startswith('candidate_probe_') and org.removeprefix('candidate_probe_').isdigit()
result['database']=sql('accontrol',f"SELECT json_build_object('fsync',current_setting('fsync'),'synchronous_commit',current_setting('synchronous_commit'),'requests',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('request_id',r.request_id,'state',r.state,'generation',r.generation,'storage_bytes',r.storage_bytes,'dispatch_started',p.dispatch_started,'lease_epoch',p.lease_epoch,'lease_owner',p.lease_owner,'reason',p.reason,'has_receipt',p.receipt IS NOT NULL,'input_revision',i.revision,'manifest_digest',v.digest)) FROM runtime_start_requests r JOIN candidate_preparations p USING(organization,request_id) JOIN runtime_start_inputs i USING(organization,request_id) JOIN workspace_input_versions v ON v.organization=i.organization AND v.workspace_id=i.workspace_id AND v.revision=i.revision WHERE r.organization='{org}'))")
result['writer_database']=sql('accontrol',f"SELECT json_build_object('epochs',(SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_writer_epochs WHERE organization='{org}'),'dispatches',(SELECT count(*) FROM candidate_writer_dispatches WHERE organization='{org}'),'completions',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('epoch',epoch,'dispatch_id',dispatch_id,'observed',observed,'accepted',accepted) ORDER BY epoch) FROM candidate_writer_completions WHERE organization='{org}'),'proofs',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('epoch',epoch,'proof',proof) ORDER BY epoch) FROM candidate_writer_drains WHERE organization='{org}'),'completion_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE organization='{org}' AND kind='writer.file_completed'),'completion_outbox',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox o JOIN events e USING(organization,sequence) WHERE e.organization='{org}' AND e.kind='writer.file_completed'))")
result['metadata_database']=sql('jfsmeta',"SELECT json_build_object('fsync',current_setting('fsync'),'synchronous_commit',current_setting('synchronous_commit'))")
pvc=next(x for x in kube('get','pvc','-n','ac-kube-component')['items'] if x['metadata']['uid']==result['pvc_uid'])
pv=next(x for x in kube('get','pv')['items'] if x['metadata']['uid']==result['pv_uid'])
result['kubernetes_objects']={'pvc':pvc,'pv':pv}
pods=kube('get','pods','-n','kube-system','-l','app.kubernetes.io/name=juicefs-csi-driver')['items']
result['csi_containers']=[{'pod':x['metadata']['name'],'containers':[{'name':c['name'],'ready':c['ready'],'image':c['image'],'image_id':c['imageID']} for c in x['status']['containerStatuses']]} for x in pods]
mount=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-juicefs/.config').read_text())
result['mount']={'storage':mount['Format']['Storage'],'filesystem_uuid':mount['Format']['UUID'],'subdir':mount.get('Subdir',''),'writeback':mount.get('Chunk',{}).get('Writeback'),'fuse_writeback':mount.get('FuseOpts',{}).get('EnableWriteback'),'read_only':mount.get('Meta',{}).get('ReadOnly')}
result['environment']={'kernel':run(['uname','-r']),'os':run(['lsb_release','-ds']),'juicefs':run(['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','version']),'postgresql':run(['/usr/lib/postgresql/16/bin/postgres','--version']),'seaweedfs':run(['/usr/local/bin/weed','version']),'k3s':run(['/usr/local/bin/k3s','--version']),'runsc':run(['/usr/local/bin/runsc','--version'])}
result['binaries']={name:digest(path) for name,path in {'candidate_worker_live_test':'/home/ac-test/candidate_worker_live_test','server':'/home/ac-test/agent-computer-server','juicefs':'/usr/local/bin/juicefs'}.items()}
result['operator_candidate_configuration']=json.loads((p/'candidate-command.json').read_text())
result['kubernetes_configuration']={k:v for k,v in config['kubernetes'].items() if k not in ('token_file','ca_file')}
# A new read-only client has no local disk cache. Check the file written and
# synchronized before the deliberately lost database acknowledgement.
cold=pathlib.Path('/mnt/ac-worker-cold');cold.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=os.environ.copy();env['META_PASSWORD_FILE']=str(p/'metadata-password')
args=['/usr/local/bin/juicefs','mount','-d','--read-only','--no-usage-report','--cache-dir','memory','--cache-size','0','--buffer-size','64','postgres://jfsmeta@10.0.2.15:5432/jfsmeta?sslmode=disable',str(cold)]
mounted=subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
(p/'worker-cold-mount.log').write_text(mounted.stdout);(p/'worker-cold-mount.log').chmod(0o600)
assert mounted.returncode==0,'cold mount failed; private log retained'
try:
    receipt=result['observations'][1]['receipt']
    file=cold/result['volume_path']/receipt['path_ref']/'preserved.txt'
    data=file.read_bytes();assert data==b'preserve-before-observation'
    saved_receipt=result['observations'][0]['receipt']
    saved=cold/result['volume_path']/saved_receipt['path_ref']/result['file_writer']['final_path']
    saved_bytes=saved.read_bytes();assert saved_bytes==b'http-saved-and-read'
    saved_hash='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(saved_bytes).hexdigest()
    assert saved_hash==result['file_writer']['final_file']['version']['sha256']
    assert len(saved_bytes)==result['file_writer']['final_file']['version']['size']
    result['fresh_saved_file_read']={'bytes':len(saved_bytes),'sha256':saved_hash,'cache':'new read-only client; cache-dir memory; cache-size 0'}
    stats=(cold/'.stats').read_text()
    result['fresh_client_read']={'bytes':len(data),'sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'cache':'new read-only client; cache-dir memory; cache-size 0','object_get_metrics':[s for s in stats.splitlines() if not s.startswith('#') and 'object' in s and 'get' in s.lower()]}
finally:
    subprocess.run(['umount',str(cold)],check=True)
# Reject accidental export of generated secrets without printing those values.
creds=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/home/ac-test/storage-private/credentials.json').read_text())
serialized=json.dumps(result)
for secret in [*creds.values(),(p/'control-url').read_text().strip(),(p/'api-token').read_text().strip()]:
    assert not secret or secret not in serialized,'private value in evidence'
(p/'candidate-file-http-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'candidate-file-http-result.json').chmod(0o600)
print('Bounded file-save evidence and fresh-client reads collected.')

metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: controller

    app.kubernetes.io/name: juicefs-csi-driver
    app.kubernetes.io/version: master

spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: juicefs-csi-controller
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: juicefs-csi-driver
      app.kubernetes.io/name: juicefs-csi-driver
      app.kubernetes.io/version: master
  serviceName: juicefs-csi-controller
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: juicefs-csi-controller
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: juicefs-csi-driver
        app.kubernetes.io/name: juicefs-csi-driver
        app.kubernetes.io/version: master
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - --endpoint=$(CSI_ENDPOINT)
        - --logtostderr
        - --nodeid=$(NODE_NAME)
        - --leader-election
        - --config=/etc/config/config.yaml
        env:
        - name: CSI_ENDPOINT
          value: unix:///var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        - name: NODE_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: spec.nodeName
        - name: JUICEFS_MOUNT_NAMESPACE
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.namespace
        - name: POD_NAME
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: metadata.name
        - name: JUICEFS_MOUNT_PATH
          value: /var/lib/juicefs/volume
        - name: JUICEFS_CONFIG_PATH
          value: /var/lib/juicefs/config
        image: mirror.gcr.io/juicedata/juicefs-csi-driver@sha256:f221e9090fb72098d3261fd6bc6ec1b3b1dec8a372882c9659bd993ca198c754
        livenessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 5
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: healthz
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        name: juicefs-plugin
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9909
          name: healthz
          protocol: TCP
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 512Mi
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            add:
            - SYS_ADMIN
          privileged: true
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/
          name: socket-dir
        - mountPath: /jfs
          mountPropagation: Bidirectional
          name: jfs-dir
        - mountPath: /root/.juicefs
          mountPropagation: Bidirectional
          name: jfs-root-dir
        - mountPath: /etc/config
          name: juicefs-config
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      - args:
        - --csi-address=$(ADDRESS)
        - --timeout=60s
        - --leader-election
        - --v=5
        env:
        - name: ADDRESS
          value: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-csi-provisioner@sha256:608640c92ee853e657ce663bc955f866910858d0f5c746da088ffb497d44a453
        name: csi-provisioner
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/
          name: socket-dir
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      - args:
        - --csi-address=$(ADDRESS)
        - --timeout=20s
        - --leader-election
        - --v=2
        env:
        - name: ADDRESS
          value: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/csi.sock
        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-csi-resizer@sha256:fc764369dcb1dd3a031b6a842e265b7a19766e6817acd1b7bcdd5c413275638b
        name: csi-resizer

        - mountPath: /var/lib/csi/sockets/pluginproxy/
          name: socket-dir

      - args:
        - --csi-address=$(ADDRESS)
        - --health-port=$(HEALTH_PORT)
        env:
        - name: ADDRESS
          value: /csi/csi.sock
        - name: HEALTH_PORT
          value: '9909'
        image: mirror.gcr.io/rancher/mirrored-sig-storage-livenessprobe@sha256:4a1e22167d03746e6748cdc41b6374262c666bc85999e90112edc236dfb2c95a
        name: liveness-probe
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /csi
          name: socket-dir
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent

      serviceAccount: juicefs-csi-controller-sa
      tolerations:
      - key: CriticalAddonsOnly

        name: socket-dir
      - hostPath:
          path: /var/lib/juicefs/volume
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
        name: jfs-dir
      - hostPath:
          path: /var/lib/juicefs/config
          type: DirectoryOrCreate
        name: jfs-root-dir
      - configMap:
          defaultMode: 420
          name: juicefs-csi-driver-config
        name: juicefs-config
  volumeClaimTemplates: []

config_patch_before_execution.api_token: Refreshed for 30 minutes in a private root-owned file; token not retained
config_patch_before_execution.apt_sources: Ubuntu source URLs use HTTPS and the host proxy; signed package verification retained.

setup_observations.outcome: The first setup called the configuration probe before the CSIDriver object existed; control database and private credentials had already been created.
setup_observations.resolution: Applied the CSI manifest, resumed only the unfinished configuration readback with resume-worker-config.py, and retained the original control database/credentials. files-setup-attempt1.sh is the exact executed setup script.

setup_observations.outcome: Initial CSI rollout waits expired while large public images were still downloading.
setup_observations.resolution: Observed the same pods until controller 4/4 and node 3/3 Ready; no product checks were bypassed.

setup_observations.outcome: Isolated Cargo index refresh was slow. Cached dependency resolution passed; the initial default lockfile-error build identified the cache isolation environment mismatch.
setup_observations.resolution: The source commit explicitly configures Cargo registry-cache reuse in .bazelrc and documents it in both languages. Default Bazel build/test with --lockfile_mode=error passed. No crate version or checksum changed. Cargo probe binaries were built and uploaded for possible preflight, but were replaced by the pinned Bazel binaries before the only live test execution.

limits: Component scope only; T01-T43 remain not_run
File HTTP routes require trusted configuration and service bearer credentials; browser Origin requests, directory listing, streaming files and the human file UI remain unavailable
At most 1 MiB per file; all Candidate writers must use the exclusive gateway; arbitrary mounted writers are not isolated
The timeout test delays database completion, not FUSE IO. No hung FUSE, node/process death, physical fencing, power loss, replication, multi-node or HA test
A worker lost before persisting sealed completion still leaves unresolved dispatch and cannot automatically retry IO
No product Pod execution, Artifact publication, stop/recover or cleanup controller; Computer stays not Ready
Operator binds the actual full mount, filesystem UUID and CSI Volume directory; test tightens CSI-created Volume root to mode 0700
Quota confirmation exercised; this probe does not repeat independent EDQUOT tests
Test environment teardown is not product cleanup or fencing evidence

cleanup.guest_state: Disposable overlay removed, including control and JuiceFS PostgreSQL databases, S3 objects, Kubernetes credentials and generated service credentials
cleanup.preserved: Existing upstream image/binary/manifest cache and sanitized evidence; public OCI image archive exported for future isolated tests, without container snapshots or secrets
cleanup.limit: Test environment teardown is not product cleanup or physical fencing evidence
